source_title: Regis le Bris press conference: Coventry vs Sunderland - BBC
source_excerpt:
Sunderland boss Regis le Bris has been speaking to the media before Saturday's Premier League game against Coventry City at CBS Arena (kick-off 15:00 GMT).
Here are the key lines from his news conference:
Wilson Isidor "should" be back in contention after missing five matches with a knock. Le Bris confirmed all of his players are "more or less available" excluding defender Dan Ballard and winger Romaine Mundle, who haven't been cleared to travel.

Dutch striker Brian Brobbey returned to the fold against Leeds United last weekend as he recovered from a hamstring injury. Le Bris said: "Brian is really important for the team. He's getting better, so hopefully he can progress."

Sunderland have drawn Crystal Palace in the Carabao Cup quarter-finals after knocking out Brentford on Wednesday. Le Bris said the draw is a "good opportunity" for his side to go further in the competition but that it is "always a tough game" at Selhurst Park.

The French head coach made 11 changes to his side that beat the Bees as he continues to manage Sunderland's European campaign on top of domestic competitions. On achieving that balance, he said: "You won't hear me complaining about this new journey, the busy schedule, because this is exactly where we want to be; with the opportunity to play regularly in Europe, competing in the Premier League, the Carabao Cup and the FA Cup later. It's demanding and creates the condition to get better, to evolve and to be more creative."
